name: Text Scroll Animation
rationale: Clean-room implementation from the one-line effect description only; no upstream source was read, and the smooth-scroll dependency was dropped so native scrolling is never hijacked.

baseOpacity.description: Opacity of a character before it animates in.

rise.description: Starting vertical offset of a character, any CSS length.

tilt.description: Starting tilt of a character around its baseline, in degrees.

spread.description: How many characters animate at once.

start.description: Viewport fraction of the host's top where progress is 0.

end.description: Viewport fraction of the host's top where progress is 1.

a11y: The per-character copy is aria-hidden; a visually hidden span carries the original text once, so screen readers read whole words, not letters.
Scrolling is never intercepted or smoothed: the effect only reads native scroll position through a passive listener.
The host keeps its element, heading level and role; with JS off the plain authored text shows at full opacity.
Reduced motion skips the split and the scroll listener entirely, and a live switch to reduce snaps every character to its final, fully legible state.
